import sys, json
d = json.load(sys.stdin)
h = d.get("header", {})
ctx = h.get("context", {})
tid = ctx.get("turn_id", "")
msgs = d.get("messages", [])
user_turn = msgs[0] if msgs else {}
op = {"operation":"insert","table":"thread",
      "row":{"turn_id":tid,"iter":0,"role":"user","turn":json.dumps(user_turn)}}
out = [
  {"header":{"route":"ustore"},
   "messages":[{"origin":"assistant","type":"tool_call","id":"u-ins","text":json.dumps(op)}]},
  {"header":{"route":"ullm"}, "system": d.get("system", {}), "messages": msgs},
]
sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(out))
